node.statement: Degenerate transverse transport: there is a universal constant C_tr (independent of dimension, rank, and instance) such that for every exact signed idempotent P (square real matrix with P^2 = P and all row sums equal to 1) with 0 < delta(P) <= 1/4 where delta(P) = max_i sum_j max(-P_ij, 0), every actual-row basis U = (u_1, ..., u_k) minimizing Phi(U) = max_s Phi_s(U) over all actual-row bases with Gram volume Vol(U) >= (1/2) * Vol_max(P) (coordinates a_t(j) defined by p_j = sum_t a_t(j) p_{u_t}, beta_s(j) = P_{u_s j}, mu_s(j) = sum_{t != s} max(-a_t(j), 0), E_s(j) = max(mu_s(j) - (1 - a_s(j)), 0), Phi_s(U) = sum_j max(beta_s(j), 0) * E_s(j)), and every pivot s, writing D_s for the set of rows j with beta_s(j) > 0, E_s(j) > 0, and every block swap keeping u_s in the chart and bringing row j into one or two transverse pivot positions having Schur volume factor |det C| <= 1/2, one has sum_{j in D_s} beta_s(j) * mu_s(j) <= C_tr * delta(P).
